description: This source file defines the internal class 'VirtualBucketsRingProvider' which implements consistent hashing for silo distribution in Orleans cluster. It manages the ring of silos, their buckets, range calculations, and notifies listeners of range changes. Key functionalities include silo membership management, range calculation, and silo target resolution based on hash keys.

classes.name: VirtualBucketsRingProvider
classes.description: Manages the ring of silos with virtual buckets, facilitates range calculation, silo resolution, and notifications in Orleans.

methods.name: GetMyRange
methods.description: Returns the current range of responsibility for the local silo.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles status changes of silos, including removal or addition of silos based on their lifecycle events.

methods.name: GetPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Returns the primary silo responsible for a given hash key.
